title: Polish cross-SDK auth orbit: compact retries, stream-pipe ergonomics, parity fixes
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: This PR wraps up a focused cross-SDK polish across Python, TypeScript, and Go that converges credential retry behaviour, tightens default retry windows for low-latency streaming, and nudges several ergonomics gaps in the streaming consumer APIs. Motivation: teams reported subtle divergence in how token refresh backoffs were applied to streaming pull/generator consumers which caused transient duplicate reauth attempts under heavy churn and complicated consumer-side retry logic. This work unifies the heuristics (compact retry bundles), provides a small ergonomic 'stream-pipe' adapter on each SDK to normalize backpressure and resume points, and applies parity fixes so example apps and docs match runtime behavior.

Summary of changes (single-line): add compact retry bundle, add StreamPipe adapter and generator/pullstream sugar, fix reauth race in credential cache, tighten default hedged retry window for streams, bump SDK versions.

Checklist:
- [x] Define compact retry bundle and default presets used by all SDKs
- [x] Implement StreamPipe adapter in py/ts/go to normalize resume/close semantics
- [x] Fix credential cache double-refresh race (server/sidecar interaction)
- [x] Update examples and docs snippets in repo/redwood-docs
- [x] Add unit + integration tests for streaming resume + auth handoff
- [x] Bump SDK versions and publish changelogs

Commits (high-level):
- 1) define: auth/compact_retry: add CompactRetryProfile and presets (py/ts/go)
- 2) implement: stream/stream_pipe: stream-pipe abstraction and adapters (py/ts/go)
- 3) fix: auth/cache: guard double-refresh with compare-and-swap and telemetry
- 4) test: add e2e streaming auth test harness (flaky stable run tuned)
- 5) docs/examples: align quickstarts and snippets
- 6) chore: bump versions to py v1.11.0, ts v1.29.0, go v1.9.2

Files changed (representative):
- redwood-sdk-python/redwood/auth/compact_retry.py (new)
- redwood-sdk-python/redwood/stream/stream_pipe.py (new)
- redwood-sdk-python/tests/test_stream_auth_handoff.py (new)
- redwood-sdk-typescript/src/auth/compactRetry.ts (new)
- redwood-sdk-typescript/src/stream/streamPipe.ts (new)
- redwood-sdk-typescript/test/stream-auth.spec.ts (new)
- redwood-sdk-go/auth/compact_retry.go (new)
- redwood-sdk-go/stream/stream_pipe.go (new)
- redwood-docs/snippets/stream-resume.md (updated)
- examples/streaming/quickstart-auth-resume.py (updated)

Testing/CI notes: initial CI run failed on the py/e2e harness due to a timing assumption in the test (flaky socket close order). I pushed a deterministic re-record and added a small jitter-resilience in the harness; the rerun succeeded. All unit suites pass; integration job (stream-e2e) passes on 3 consecutive runs in the CI matrix. Lint/format checks ran and were auto-fixed in TS and Go. Release checklist completed and publish pipeline triggered after merge.

Review thread summary: 
- Priya Patel requested clarifying the compact profile naming and suggested "compact-hedged" for the default streaming preset; accepted and renamed.
- Liam O'Connor flagged a potential edge-case where StreamPipe.resume() could mask an upstream transport EOF and cause a retry loop; I added an explicit terminal-state check and unit tests to assert no replays after EOF.
- Diego Ramos asked for telemetry counters for "reauth-attempt" and "reauth-suppressed"; counters were added and surfaced in SDK telemetry schemas.
- Author replies: clarified the semantics of the compact profile (short, low-cost hedged retries as safe defaults) and why the adapter exists (to unify consumer surface without forcing large API changes).

Compatibility notes: This is backward compatible for typical callers. A few advanced users who relied on previous unbounded hedged retry windows must explicitly opt into the legacy profile; documentation and a migration snippet are included. No breaking changes to public call signatures were made.

Release notes (brief): consolidated compact retry preset (default for streaming), StreamPipe adapter for normalized resume/close, credential cache race fixed, small SDK bumps (py v1.11.0, ts v1.29.0, go v1.9.2), improved telemetry around reauth events.

Merge outcome: squash-merge to main. Post-merge actions: publish new SDK packages (CI release jobs), update docs site with the new quickstart snippet, and schedule a short follow-up patch to adjust default presets if telemetry indicates widespread regressions.
release_notes: Consolidated compact retry preset as streaming default; added StreamPipe adapter across SDKs; fixed credential-cache double-refresh race; bumped SDK versions (py 1.11.0, ts 1.29.0, go 1.9.2); added telemetry for reauth events.
